subject: Post-demo: volume sensitivity & startup program — next steps
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: volume sensitivity & startup program — next steps

Hi Liam — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can size a tailored offer: 

1) Usage profile you shared: you said 150k user interactions/month with an average prompt+response of ~600 tokens. Can you confirm whether that 150k is unique users or sessions? Also, is the 600-token estimate per session or per API call?

2) Budget band: you mentioned a $8k–$12k/mo budget initially, but that sounded like short runway. Can you share a target $/1M tokens you consider acceptable (ballpark)? That'll help us run unit-econ scenarios.

3) Startup program/discount: Redwood's founders program can provide credits + a 20% starter discount for qualified seed-stage companies. To fast-track approval we need: latest cap table or investor email, and rough ARR estimate. 

Attaching a simple token forecast template — if you can fill the highlighted rows (monthly activists, mean tokens/session, pct.peak) we'll produce a modeled price path and 12/24-month commitment options.

Next steps I propose: you send the completed forecast (attached) and confirm whether procurement needs an MSA or PO before signing. Ben from Pricing is looped for a draft structure we can present. 

Thanks — appreciate the candor on pricing sensitivity.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Nimble_Token_Forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@nimblehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen@nimblehealth.com>, contracts@nimblehealth.com
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 09:27:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: volume sensitivity & startup program — next steps

Vanessa — thanks for the recap and for the clear asks. Quick answers inline: 

- 150k = sessions per month (roughly 1 per active user; user base ~40k).
- 600 tokens = average tokens per session (prompt + response).
- Budget: current internal target is $10k/mo but we can stretch if unit economics look favorable — target ~$900/1M tokens to start, but we'd consider up to $700/1M with committed pricing.

I've attached a filled version of your forecast with conservative and aggressive lanes. Also attaching a short note from Ellen (CFO) about procurement timing; they prefer an MSA and quote to go through procurement before PO.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call this week to walk through the forecast if helpful.

— Liam
Head of Product, Nimble Health
Attachments: Nimble_Token_Forecast_filled.xlsx (spreadsheet), CFO_note.pdf (procurement timing)
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'nimble <liam@nimblehealth.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 12:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: volume sensitivity & startup program — next steps

Hi Liam — appreciate the filled forecast, helped a lot. High-level pricing sketched below (all $/1M tokens, post any credits):

- On-demand: $1200/1M tokens (baseline hosted rate)
- Startup program (founder credits + starter): effective $960/1M first 3 months (20% starter discount + $3k credit applied)
- Committed 6mo: $800/1M with a 6-month minimum commit at your conservative lane (6mo average tokens)
- Multi-year (2yr) stretch: $650/1M with volume breakpoints and annual true-ups (requires minimal purchase commitment and doced SLA)

Given your target of ~$900/1M, the 6-month committed option lands close at $800/1M. If procurement prefers an MSA-first flow, we can attach a draft MSA and present a purchase schedule that mirrors the forecast. 

Couple of clarifying asks before we lock numbers: 
- Can you confirm peak concurrency tolerance? High concurrency impacts slot sizing and can nudge us toward a slightly higher committed price if sustained.
- Is there a data residency or audit requirement beyond SOC 2?

If you confirm procurement wants an MSA/quote path, we can produce a PDF quote and a DocuSign packet for Ellen to review. Priyom is on copy to validate committed band math and multi-year uplift.

— Ben Carter
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Ellen Park <ellen@nimblehealth.com>, contracts@nimblehealth.com
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: volume sensitivity & startup program — next steps

Thanks everyone — quick operational plan to keep momentum: 

1) Liam / Ellen: please confirm peak concurrency (est. number of simultaneous sessions at 95th pct) and whether SOC2 + ISO attestation suffices for procurement. If there are additional residency needs flag them now.

2) Nimble: if you sign the attached 6-month Purchase Schedule (PDF) we will: apply the startup credits immediately, lock the $800/1M committed rate, and reserve capacity for your 6-month conservative lane. Attached is a light MSA addendum and a proposed multi-year schedule for visibility (non-binding unless you opt-in).

3) Redwood ops: Ben / Priyom, please produce the 6-month quote PDF and a DocuSign envelope keyed to DL-2027-0987; include the starter credit callout and the credit expiry (90 days). 

Would love to get the signed schedule by EOD next Tue (6 Jun) to lock onboarding for mid-June. Happy to jump on a 15-min call if it helps move procurement along.

— Vanessa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: Proposed_MultiYear_Schedule.pdf, Redwood_Startup_Terms.pdf, Nimble_Token_Forecast_filled.xlsx
